annotations.title: Read a page of gene records

description: Read a gene-profile section using gene_id, snapshot_id and its returned opaque cursor. Returns source records, assembly/release, coverage, totals, count units and provenance. snapshot_unavailable requires a fresh resolution/profile request.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned for this same gene, snapshot and section. Omit for its first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

gene_id.description: Canonical HGNC gene_id returned by resolve_gene. Select an explicit candidate when resolution is ambiguous.
gene_id.title: Gene Id

limit.description: Maximum source records per page, from 1 to 50. Counts retain their original source unit.
limit.title: Limit

section.description: Source-qualified section from the current profile. Literature is a separate live capture; use search_gene_literature for it.
section.title: Section

snapshot_id.description: identity_snapshot_id returned by resolve_gene, or snapshot_id from the current gene profile. Restart resolution after snapshot_unavailable.
snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id

name: get_gene_section
title: Read a page of gene records
